name: zidoo-turns-warm-dsf
note: The network player of #456 starting a 6-channel DSF track again a few minutes after the last start (--format dsf): a probe of the track, re-reads of the other 11 files' heads and tails one file at a time, and the playing handle opened once 5 of them are done (round 4 trace, build a4d50e5, reader 99; rounds 4 and 5 opened it after 5 to 7), taking turns with the rest: it sends its track's next read when a re-read is answered. Rate 3.5 and lead 4 s as zidoo-turns-dsf. Turns and play_after_heads are set by hand: most re-reads come before the playing handle, so the trace cannot show turns. Run it as zidoo-turns-warm-dsf.json@idle in the stall gate: after the idle release, with the kept heads. `browse` is the probe it makes when it lists the album (zidoo-turns-dsf's, round 4): run it as zidoo-turns-warm-dsf.json@probe:D for the first start D seconds after that (#510).
